description: The screen sizes one site is designed and checked at: each standard size with its width and height in CSS pixels, whether it is on, its share of the site's page views over the last 30 days (pageViewsPercent, a whole percent or "under 1"; absent when the site has no recorded visits), plus the sizes the owner added (added: name, widthPx, heightPx), and whether the person may change them. Every standard size is on unless the owner turned it off. Changing them is set_screen_sizes.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: get_screen_sizes
title: Screen sizes
